content.rendered:
What We Do Architecture Matters P/L designs and facilitates the delivery of high quality, well considered, energy efficient and cost effective residential, commercial and public buildings throughout metropolitan Melbourne and regional Victoria.

Architecture Matters P/L looks to the project site, the client’s project brief, aspirations and budget and an understanding of regulatory controls underpinned by decades of experience to realise buildings of beauty, utility, interest and amenity.

We actively pursue new and innovative software options to assist with increased design flexibility, accuracy and efficiency, including ArchiCAD (CAD); NATSPEC (specifications); and Architect’s Office (administrative). The BIM systems underlying ArchiCAD enable Architecture Matters to provide dynamic and versatile 3D design and documentation packages throughout all stages of the architectural service. This assists with usability and accuracy as well as improving communication for clients who may otherwise find difficulty in comprehending traditional architectural presentations and documentation.
